text:
The replica servo can't hold the output DC at a gain of 355: a ~0.03% current mismatch rails the output. The new program sets the DC point with a small trim PMOS whose gate takes the low-pass-filtered output.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "The replica servo can't set the DC level of a high-gain node, so the output railed. A small long-L trim PMOS with its gate on the filtered output now sets the output DC. A mirrored PMOS cascode supplies 75% of I, and the cascode gate comes from a mirrored current into a resistor."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (20e-6, 14e-6, 24e-6),
    "frac":   (0.25, 0.15, 0.4),
    "gmid_t": (6.0, 4.0, 10.0),
    "Lt":     (4.0, 1.0, 6.0),
    "L1":     (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid3":  (14.0, 9.0, 20.0),
    "L3":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_p": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "Lp":     (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),
    "gmid5":  (14.0, 9.0, 20.0),
    "L5":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "vds1t":  (0.25, 0.18, 0.4),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", spec.get("vcm", 0.75))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I = p["I"]
    It = p["frac"] * I          # trim device current (DC servo)
    I2 = I - It                 # mirrored PMOS source current
    Ipb = 2.5e-6                # PMOS mirror reference branch
    Ipc = 2.5e-6                # cascode-gate resistor branch
    vds1 = p["vds1t"]

    # trim PMOS: gate = filtered vout -> vout_dc = vdd - vsg_t
    vsd_t = 0.85
    for _ in range(4):
        mt = lut.size("p", p["gmid_t"], p["Lt"], It, vds=vsd_t)
        vsd_t = mt.vgs
    vout_t = vdd - mt.vgs

    # PMOS cascode current source
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=0.25)
    vsd2 = max(m2.vdsat + 0.1, 0.2)
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=vsd2)
    y = vdd - vsd2
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], I2, vds=max(y - vout_t, 0.1))
    pc = y - m5.vgs
    Rc = (vdd - pc) / Ipc
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ipb, vds=m2.vgs)

    # input device
    o1 = lut.op("n", 1.0, p["L1"], vin, vds1)
    W1 = max(0.42, I / max(o1["Id"], 1e-15))

    # NMOS cascode bias from ibias diode
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I, vds=max(vout_t - vds1, 0.1), vsb=vds1)
    vbn_t = m3.vgs + vds1
    lo, hi = 1.5, 25.0
    for _ in range(30):
        g = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        t = lut.size("n", g, 2.0, iref, vds=vbn_t)
        if t.vgs > vbn_t:
            lo = g
        else:
            hi = g
    gb = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gb, 2.0, iref, vds=vbn_t)
    vbn = mb0.vgs
    for _ in range(3):
        m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I, vds=max(vout_t - vds1, 0.1), vsb=vds1)
        vds1 = max(vbn - m3.vgs, 0.1)
    mbp = lut.size("n", gb, 2.0, Ipb, vds=max(vdd - m6.vgs, 0.2))
    mbc = lut.size("n", gb, 2.0, Ipc, vds=max(pc, 0.2))

    o1 = lut.op("n", W1, p["L1"], vin, vds1)
    gm1, gds1 = o1["gm"], o1["gds"]

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mb0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("Mbp", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbp)
    n.dev("M6", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("Mbc", "pc", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbc)
    n.R("Rc", "vdd", "pc", Rc)
    # main branch
    n.dev("M2", "y", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("M5", "vout", "pc", "y", "y", m5)
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "ibias", "x", "vss", m3)
    n.M("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, p["L1"])
    # DC servo: trim PMOS with low-pass filtered output on its gate
    n.dev("Mt", "vout", "vf", "vdd", "vdd", mt)
    n.R("Rf", "vout", "vf", 1e9)
    n.C("Cf", "vf", "vdd", 1e-9)

    gout_n = gds1 * m3.gds / (m3.gm + m3.gmbs + m3.gds)
    gout_p = m2.gds * m5.gds / (m5.gm + m5.gds)
    rout = 1.0 / (gout_n + gout_p + mt.gds)
    A = gm1 * rout
    ctot = cl + m5.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgd + m3.cgd + mt.cdd
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rout * ctot)
    vlow = vds1 + m3.vdsat + 0.05
    vhigh = y - m5.vdsat - 0.05
    power = vdd * (iref + I + Ipb + Ipc)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "gbw": gbw, "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_t, "swing": vhigh - vlow}
```

The predicted output DC is about 0.95 V with a swing of roughly 0.7 V. Power should be about 63 µW from 35 µA total.

The DC loop through the 1 GΩ / 1 nF filter cuts gain below about 5 Hz. If the AC sweep starts near 1 Hz, measured DC gain will come out low. In that case the next fix is a larger filter capacitor or a smaller trim fraction.
